-- 为所有用户添加"周关注"、"月关注"、"季关注"三个默认全局标签
-- 使用 INSERT IGNORE 避免重复插入

INSERT IGNORE INTO contact_tags (parentUserId, name, color, sortOrder, isPreset, createdAt)
SELECT 
  id as parentUserId,
  '周关注' as name,
  '#3b82f6' as color,
  1 as sortOrder,
  0 as isPreset,
  NOW() as createdAt
FROM users;

INSERT IGNORE INTO contact_tags (parentUserId, name, color, sortOrder, isPreset, createdAt)
SELECT 
  id as parentUserId,
  '月关注' as name,
  '#10b981' as color,
  2 as sortOrder,
  0 as isPreset,
  NOW() as createdAt
FROM users;

INSERT IGNORE INTO contact_tags (parentUserId, name, color, sortOrder, isPreset, createdAt)
SELECT 
  id as parentUserId,
  '季关注' as name,
  '#f59e0b' as color,
  3 as sortOrder,
  0 as isPreset,
  NOW() as createdAt
FROM users;
